title: A thermal spa, one cold evening
intro: Guests move between the hot pool, the sauna, the cold plunge and a quiet terrace with heaters. The air cools after sunset, a coach group arrives, the terrace heating fails, a loud group drifts into the quiet zone, and one guest is having a hard evening.

decision.why: The terrace is for rest and the lights are up; lower light helps people settle.
The terrace is louder than a quiet zone should be; the soundscape goes down first.
The terrace is getting cold for guests resting there.

events: A coach group of ten arrives and heads for the circuit.

decision.why: The sauna queue will reach 13 in six minutes at this rate.

events: A guest who paired a watch at check-in sits alone on the terrace, upset.

decision.why: The sauna queue will reach 6 in six minutes at this rate.
One guest's own watch reads stressed and low for several minutes; someone should go to them.

team.why: heaters on, as every evening at 18:30

events: Four friends settle on the quiet terrace, laughing and talking loudly.

decision.why: The terrace reads tense; a member of staff can check on the guests there.

events: The terrace heating fails. It stays switched on, and gives no heat.

team.why: staff notice the noise and invite the group to the fire pit
